title: ConfigChange
description: common.config-change@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of POST /internal/config/:namespace on a service's openvibe-shared/config admin routes. It proposes a new revision of the namespace and activates it (the store validates against the namespace schema, applies env pins and calls onActivate). `merge: true` starts from the active values; otherwise `values` is the whole new set. `unset` removes keys. A secret-class key's value is never sent here: it is 422 config.secret_write_only; use common.config-secret-put@1.

values.description: The new values, one member per key. The store validates them against the namespace schema; a secret-class value here is refused.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value; a redaction marker keeps the value it stands for.

reason.description: Why the change is made; it is the revision's reason in the history.

merge.description: Merge into the active values instead of replacing them.

unset.description: Keys to remove from the new revision.
